modelDescription: The next evolution of our Mesa line, the Mesa Long Range was designed for dedicated precision shooters and long range hunters. The sturdy and ergonomic platform relies on a medium palma contour steel barrel paired with an adjustable carbon fiber composite gunstock and features a seamless removable side-baffle muzzle brake. The Mesa Long Range weighs in starting at 8.9 pounds and is backed by the Christensen Arms Sub-MOA Guarantee.
